name: Facet Warbeard
description: Weight settles behind the haft in a low guard that readies the single great chop.

name: Blaze Crescentbit
description: The bit finds the grain of a shield and drops along it, splitting the board.

name: Warbitcuirass
description: The poll raps along a shield's face to find the seam where the next cut will land.

name: Might Warpoll
description: The user steps back and wrenches the bit free from split wood before it can bind.

name: Gust Bitedge
description: A qi-backed chop strikes the shield's rim and shatters the hold of its bearer.

name: Toxinbanded
description: Two heavy chops land in the same spot, tearing a guard open and driving the opponent's arm aside.

name: Rumble Wideeye
description: A great cleave carries qi through the shield and strikes the bearer behind it.

name: Gust Banded
description: After a long draw-back the head falls with all its qi and breaks both shield and stance together.

name: Iron Warbit
description: The head is held aloft above the brow, covering the user while its weight gathers for a drop.

name: Needling Rive
description: The head falls from a full overhead lift, cutting through guard and armour in one stroke.

name: Granite Brunt
description: With the head held aloft the user steps lightly to the side of the opponent's counter.

name: Vitalbanded
description: Qi settles in the raised head so the next fall carries far more force than the arms give.

name: Murk Haftcap
description: A falling head catches a blade at its weakest point and drives it to the ground.

name: Thorn Smite
description: The haft is pressed down on a trapped blade, pinning it to the earth by the head's settling weight.

name: Lambasting Battleheel
description: A narrow falling cut sends qi through the edge, and it cleaves cover along one line.

name: Warhelve Maelstrom
description: The head falls with a great gathering of qi and the ground jolts the footing of nearby foes.

name: Gust Warpoll
description: A rebounding step returns the head to its high guard after a great drop.

name: Discerning Warbit
description: The user studies the opponent's plates and straps and notes where the edge will bite.

name: Warbitbarrage
description: The bit cuts a strap or buckle of the armour, loosening a plate.

name: Thorn Hewdown
description: The beard hooks the rim of a plate and pulls it away from the body.

name: Hoarfrost Warhelve
description: The haft braces against a rush while the user's feet hold the ground.

name: Brunt Canter
description: A planted step puts the user's weight behind the heavy head for the next cut.

name: Granite Crescentbit
description: A chop with qi in the edge breaks through mail and the padding beneath.

name: Crippling Hewdown
description: A hammering poll blow dents a plate inward and jars the bearer's ribs.

name: Splitting Warcleave
description: A narrow chop forces the edge into an armour seam and opens it to the body.

name: Suppressing Battercut
description: A hooked plate is torn from the armour with a steady pull, baring the opponent's body.

name: Dense Battercut
description: With a long swing and gathered qi the axe cleaves plate armour as if it were bark.

name: Bitedge Cuirass
description: Both hands hold the haft's far end and keep the head between user and opponent.

name: Scalding Rive
description: A long swing strikes from beyond the opponent's reach, the bit biting at the end of its arc.

name: Granite Battleheel
description: A long gliding step matches the haft's length, closing and opening distance in the same motion.

name: Rumblebrunt
description: The poll raps the nearest hand or wrist and holds the opponent outside his own reach.

name: Nova Haftcap
description: Qi stretches the edge beyond the steel and the cut lands a hand's span past the bit.

name: Rivebarrage
description: A full-reach sweeping cut cuts across every opponent at the end of the haft.

name: Fastening Warcleave
description: The beard hooks an opponent's weapon at the end of the reach and pulls it out wide.

name: Chime Warbeard
description: A long axe turning in front of the user turns thrusts and thrown weapons.

name: Transfixing Banded
description: A heavy cut splits the opponent's guard and leaves him open to the user's counter.

name: Torrent Wideeye
description: The haft catches the blow that follows a cleft and turns it away.

name: Iron Crescentbit
description: A chop lands in the mark of an earlier cut and deepens the wound.

name: Silt Haftcap
description: A step to one side resets the bit onto a fresh line while the opponent turns.

name: Dominating Warcleave
description: The beard hooks and pulls and the bit chops as the opponent leans in.

name: Warbitgreave
description: A poll blow answers a strike and shakes the weapon arm of the attacker.

name: Facetwarbit
description: A held counter guard waits with the head cocked, ready to answer any blow.

name: Bandedassault
description: A counter and a cleft cut follow one another, each opening the way for the next.

name: Waning Warbeard
description: Qi in the haft throws a blow back toward its source.

name: Wrecking Smite
description: A counter-cleave with gathered qi passes through the opponent's guard and strikes the body.

name: Crippling Deed Rive
description: The head is set down on an opponent's weapon arm and held until his strength fails.

name: Aegisbattle
description: Weight and qi are held in two tracks along the body, steadying the user under a heavy axe.

name: Blaze Battercut
description: Qi runs in the arms while the steel cuts, and the two tracks join at the bit.

name: Mayhem Warpoll
description: The poll raps an opponent's wrist, setting up the qi cut that follows.

name: Silt Bitedge
description: A step crosses from one track of the stance to the other and carries the user to the opponent's flank.

name: Drubbing Wideeye
description: Two chops cross one another, one from the qi track and one from the steel track.

name: Annealed Warhelve
description: The haft parries on the steel track as qi in the arms drives the counter.

name: Nova Smite
description: Qi in the edge and weight in the haft combine in one cut that pierces a guard.

name: Unshaken Battleheel
description: Qi tracks and steel tracks meet at the haft, returning a blow to its source.

name: Downpour Banded
description: The user gathers qi along both tracks and then releases it in one wide cleave.

name: Unflinching Warbit
description: The user holds a high guard like a hawk on its perch and waits for the opening.

name: Mightbattle
description: The user drops from the high guard in a swift diving chop.

name: Granite Haftcap
description: A long, low step carries the user beneath the opponent's guard in a single dive.

name: Hewdown Cloak
description: The beard hooks the opponent's shoulder or shield like a talon and draws him in.

name: Scorching Banded
description: The axe sweeps wide like a spread wing and strikes the opponent's flank as he turns.

name: Warbitelixir
description: The user watches the opponent from above his guard and learns where his weight will go.

name: Equipoise Wideeye
description: The axe banks across the body like a turning hawk and turns a blow aside.

name: Novarive
description: A narrow dive passes through the guard on one line and strikes the body beyond it.

name: Blaze Brunt
description: Two stoops follow one another from opposite sides, and the second strikes the open guard.

name: Battleremedy
description: Qi gathers in the raised head, and the following stoop carries it into the target.

name: Furrowing Nova Brunt
description: After a long hover the axe falls in a great qi-backed cleave that no guard stops.

name: Veritywarbit
description: At the height of the stoop a burst of qi throws any counter back upon the attacker.

name: Granite Warhelve
description: Bit and beard are held to the two sides of the body, covering both flanks.

name: Blazebanded
description: The bit cuts high and the beard follows from low in the same turn.

name: Subduing Warcleave
description: The beard hooks a limb or weapon while the bit strikes its twin.

name: Might Hewdown
description: The beard leads the step and the bit follows, matching a paired stride.

name: Bandedcuirass
description: Beard catches and bit strikes, turning a thrust aside and answering at once.

name: Bandedelixir
description: Qi runs to both edges of the head and each is sharpened for the cuts ahead.

name: Splitting Smite
description: The paired edges strike one spot twice in a breath, breaking through armour.

name: Lot Battleheel
description: The beard hooks and the bit presses, locking an opponent's weapon for a moment.

name: Facetbanded
description: The axe is held in a wide guard like a basin, and the user receives each blow into it.

name: Tearing Battercut
description: The axe follows a curving line like a river's bend and strikes the flank.

name: Careening Crescentbit
description: A smooth, flowing step carries the user around the opponent without a break in motion.

name: Fastening Rive
description: The beard hooks the opponent's weapon and draws it along the current of a long curving pull.

name: Tempered Banded
description: Chop follows chop in quick sequence, filling the opponent's guard like water filling a basin.

name: Chime Warbit
description: The user's qi follows the flow of the opponent's movement and finds where it is weakest.

name: Murkbanded
description: The haft sets a weir against the blow, turning its force along the side.

name: Wideeye Assault
description: The gathered qi in the head spills over in one piercing strike.

name: Rumble Warbeard
description: The haft hooks and drags the opponent's footing from beneath him in a pulling sweep.

name: Rive Assault
description: Qi gathers and is released in a great sweeping cleave that floods across the whole front.

name: Granite Warpoll
description: The user stands square on open ground with no wall at the back, relying on the haft and the wind.

name: Severing Bitedge
description: The user faces into the wind and chops, letting the headwind steady the swing.

name: Silt Brunt
description: A step along the line of the plateau's edge keeps the opponent in front and the ground behind.

name: Chime Crescentbit
description: A parry taken on a fixed bearing turns a blow and keeps the user's line unchanged.

name: Harpooning Battleheel
description: The axe falls with the wind at the user's back, adding speed to the cut.

name: Vitalbattle
description: The user steadies breath and qi on a sworn word and the head grows heavy for the next swing.

name: Dominating Haftcap
description: The haft sweeps across an opponent's legs on the wind's side and breaks his stance.

name: Glint Warbit
description: A burst of qi in the haft throws a blow back upon its source like a gust.

name: Slagbanded
description: Qi gathers and goes out in a great sweeping cleave across the open ground.

name: Aegis Warhelve
description: The user holds the axe on one fixed bearing, turning the opponent into the line of the head.

name: Mightwarbit
description: A hard chop falls like a gust, and the head bites at the end of its arc.

name: Glancing Warcleave
description: A step along the bearing carries the user straight at the target without a swerve.

name: Gyvebrunt
description: The beard hooks and draws the opponent into the line of the cleave.

name: Might Bitedge
description: Qi gathers in the head and builds like wind, adding weight to the cuts that follow.

name: Warpoll Cloak
description: The haft meets a blow from the side and carries it along the line of the wind.

name: Glintbrunt
description: The user holds the bearing while qi gathers, then the cleave falls like a gale along one line.

name: Daybreak Warbeard
description: A wide sweeping cut spreads qi in a gale-like arc across the front.

name: Thornwarbit
description: The user plants into the wind and holds the head above the brow.

name: Iron Smite
description: A chop thrown into the wind lands slowly but cuts deep.

name: Warhelve Sprint
description: A step along the line of the wind keeps the user's guard facing the opponent.

name: Warbitcloak
description: A sworn stillness holds the haft against a push, and the user does not give ground.

name: Sanguine Bitedge
description: Two chops are thrown along a single bearing and the second strikes the same mark.

name: Mayhem Hewdown
description: The poll raps a weapon hand from the wind's side, unseating the grip.

name: Thorn Wideeye
description: The beard hooks and draws the opponent onto the user's fixed bearing.

name: Anointing Battleheel
description: Qi rises with the breath and gathers in the head for a heavy swing.

name: Chimebanded
description: The user turns a blow to the side with the haft and holds the bearing without a step.

name: Battercut Thrash
description: A narrow cut carries qi through the opponent's guard on the line of the wind.

name: Fastening Brunt
description: The head presses down on the opponent's weapon arm and holds it by the weight of the gathered wind.

name: Annealed Warpoll
description: The user stands on a sworn bearing and holds the head in a steady guard.

name: Scything Crescentbit
description: A straight cut falls along the user's sworn bearing without a swerve.

name: Bandedleap
description: A step along the edge of the plateau carries the user to the opponent's open side.

name: Compressing Warbeard
description: The beard hooks and draws the opponent along the sworn line.

name: Equipoise Haftcap
description: The haft meets a blow and turns it away on the user's sworn bearing.

name: Warbitlinctus
description: Qi rises on a sworn word and settles in the head for the next great cut.

name: Heavy Banded
description: A narrow cut passes through armour on the sworn line and does not waver.

name: Iron Battercut
description: The head falls with the wind behind it and sunders the guard.

name: Scorching Warbit
description: Qi rises as a gale and goes out in a single sworn cleave across the whole front.
